Statement: In a committed log of up to 64 moderated samples for a window, the share rejected is at least the policy minimum: rejected * 10000 >= total_samples * min_rejection_bps.

min_rejection_bps.description: Minimum rejected share in basis points. The verifier refuses a proof whose minimum is lower than the registry policy.

window_ref.description: Non-zero reference to the attested window.

total_samples.description: Number of samples in the log, 1 to 64.

sample_hashes.description: Hash of each moderated sample; unused slots are zero.

rejected.description: The filter decision for each sample; unused slots are false.

salt.description: Random blinding value for the log commitment.

log_commitment.description: Poseidon2(DOMAIN, window_ref, total_samples, salt, sample_hash[0], rejected[0], ...). Lets an auditor ask for any entry later.

Limits: Binds the prover to the log it committed to. It cannot show which model made the decisions.
